{"m": "gpt-4o", "msg": [{"content": "You compare short personal anecdotes by their underlying relational structure - the pattern of intentions, causes, deceptions, reversals, and outcomes among the people involved - NOT by their surface topic, setting, or vocabulary. Two stories can be about totally different situations yet share the same deep structure; two stories can share the same topic yet have opposite structure.", "role": "system"}, {"content": "SITUATION:
My negotiation skills made me the top sales closer in the region. I couldn't turn them off. I negotiated vacation plans with my wife, chore divisions with my kids, even restaurant choices with friends. Everyone stopped wanting to do things with me. The skill that earned millions cost me my family and friendships.

CANDIDATE A:
My negotiation skills made me the top sales closer in the region, but I learned to switch them off at home. When my wife wants Thai food and I want Italian, I just say 'Thai sounds good.' I save the tactics for clients who expect them. The skill that earns millions stays at work where it belongs.

CANDIDATE B:
My photographic memory made me valedictorian and earned me scholarships. But I couldn't forget anything—every slight, every embarrassment, every failure played in perfect clarity. I developed anxiety so severe I couldn't leave my apartment. The gift that opened every door eventually closed them all.

Which candidate shares the same underlying relational structure as the SITUATION (ignore surface topic similarity)? Respond as JSON: {"choice": "A" or "B", "reason": "<one sentence>"}.", "role": "user"}], "t": 0.0, "tag": "exp2:36"}
content: {"choice": "B", "reason": "Both stories involve a skill or trait that initially brings success but ultimately leads to personal isolation and negative consequences."}
